name: One Ring Finance
rootCause: Flashloan & Price Oracle Manipulation. Lost: $1.45 million

descriptions.text: Flashloan & Price Oracle Manipulation. Lost: $1.45 million

Incorrect price calculation via reverse. Vulnerable code snippet: https://ftmscan.com/address/0x66a13cd7ea0ba9eb4c16d9951f410008f7be3a10#code#F1#L216 https://ftmscan.com/address/0xdbc07e219ba0cb5fddcd0fa0c5cc1eddfb77e082#code#F2#L378

Fantom ecological Stablecoin revenue optimizer OneRing issued a document saying that hackers stole 1,454,672.244369 USDC through flash loan attacks, and the contract has been configured to self-destruct in a specific block, so it is almost impossible to track which specific functions in the contract are called to steal funds. .

On March 21, 2022, OneRing Finance on Fantom was exploited via flashloan-enabled manipulation of LP reserves and OShare token pricing, resulting in the direct theft of $1,454,672.24 USDC and total economic loss near $2M. The protocol’s spot price calculation allowed extraction of excess vault shares in a single block. The vault relied on the live LP reserve balance to calculate OShare price, allowing flashloan-driven manipulation. Lack of time-weighted pricing or resistant oracle enabled attacker extraction of excess shares via artificially inflated spot price.
